name: fastgpt-workflow-expert
description: Build and troubleshoot FastGPT workflows and knowledge bases; analyze conversation logs and deliver verifiable JSON with version and test evidence.

displayDescription.zh: FastGPT工作流与知识库专家，提供需求设计与对话日志分析、知识库优化及接口排障，交付可验证的流程
displayDescription.en: FastGPT workflows and knowledge bases: design JSON, analyze conversation logs, improve retrieval and answers, troubleshoot APIs and verify changes.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的业务需求，设计 FastGPT 工作流并生成待导入验证的 JSON，说明需要绑定的模型和接口。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a FastGPT workflow from my requirements, generate candidate import JSON and list required model and API bindings.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的业务需求，设计 FastGPT 工作流并生成待导入验证的 JSON，说明需要绑定的模型和接口。
quickPrompts.en: Design a FastGPT workflow from my requirements, generate candidate import JSON and list required model and API bindings.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这份 FastGPT 工作流与测试记录，核对输入路由、连线和证据是否一致，交付修复建议。
quickPrompts.en: Check this FastGPT workflow and test record for routing, edge and evidence consistency; propose fixes.

quickPrompts.zh: 结合 FastGPT 对话日志 Excel/CSV、当前工作流 JSON 和知识库，先列出问题案例与改进建议，确认后再输出优化文件。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze FastGPT conversation logs, the current workflow and knowledge base; list cases and recommendations for my review before producing optimized files.
